header.label: Window frame design
header.title: Open Frame Studio
header.desc: Free, open-source software for designing, documenting and exporting window and door frames. From 2D drawing and 3D view to frame schedule, workshop drawing and IFC export.

shots.s1: Open Frame Studio — 3D view of a meranti tilt-and-turn window, with the frame properties on the right
shots.s2: Open Frame Studio — 2D frame editor with the dimensions of a 900 × 1400 mm tilt-and-turn window
shots.s3: Open Frame Studio — Frame schedule with mark, sizes, material, glazing and Ug value per frame
shots.s4: Open Frame Studio — Profile editor with the section of a 67 × 114 mm timber frame profile and the profile library

what.title: What is Open Frame Studio?
what.desc: A desktop application for designing, documenting and exporting window and door frames — a free, professional alternative to commercial frame software. Draw the frame in 2D, check it in 3D and deliver the frame schedule, workshop drawing and IFC file from the same model.

m1.title: Timber
m1.desc: KVT standard profiles (54, 67, 78 and 90 mm), meranti, accoya, spruce, oak, FSC hardwood and softwood.

m2.title: Aluminium
m2.desc: Standard aluminium profiles, with 45° mitred corners.

m3.title: uPVC
m3.desc: Standard uPVC profiles and templates from VEKA, Kömmerling and others.

m4.title: Timber-aluminium
m4.desc: Combination profiles with timber inside and aluminium outside.

editor.title: 2D frame editor
editor.desc: Interactive editor with grid subdivision, drag handles, dimension lines and infills: glass, sash, door, panel or parapet.

profiles.title: Profile editor
profiles.desc: Edit a profile cross-section point by point, with mirroring, snap grid and undo.

library.title: 80+ profiles
library.desc: Profile library for timber, aluminium, uPVC and timber-aluminium with realistic rebate sections.

templates.title: Templates
templates.desc: Tilt-and-turn window, double tilt-and-turn, sliding door, front door, stable door and your own templates to build on.

view3d.title: 3D view
view3d.desc: Three.js preview with extruded profiles, glass in the rebate and the surrounding masonry.

ai.title: AI configurator
ai.desc: Type "Make a tilt-and-turn 900×1400" and the frame is there. Works with OpenAI, Ollama or any compatible endpoint.

schedule.title: Frame schedule
schedule.desc: Professional frame schedule as PDF and Excel, with sizes, material, glazing and Ug value per frame.

workshop.title: Workshop drawing
workshop.desc: A3 workshop drawings with title block, and DXF drawings with dimension lines for the workshop.

ifc.title: IFC export
ifc.desc: IFC files with the ILS Houten Kozijnen v2.0 property sets, for BIM workflows.

cutting.title: Cutting list and joints
cutting.desc: A cutting list that follows the drawing, with joints by the book: tenoned timber, mitres for aluminium and uPVC.

conventions.title: Dutch drawing conventions
conventions.desc: Dimensioning to NEN 3576 and opening symbols to VKG and EN 12519 in the outside view.

blender.title: Blender and Bonsai
blender.desc: Send frames straight to Blender with Bonsai for further IFC modelling.

tech.title: Technology
tech.desc: A Rust core (ofs-core) for the data model, the geometry and every export (IFC, DXF, PDF, glTF, XLSX, CSV), a Svelte 5 interface with Three.js for 3D, and Tauri 2 for Windows, macOS and Linux. The same core runs as WebAssembly in the browser version.
